alerts.title: Iran war live: IRGC attacks US unmanned vessel in Hormuz; two ships hit
alerts.why: Attack in Strait of Hormuz threatens critical global crude chokepoint and spikes geopolitical risk premium, driving safe-haven and energy bids.

alerts.title: Two Tankers Attacked on Omani Route in Strait of Hormuz, Brent Hits $108
alerts.why: Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz directly threaten critical crude transit chokepoints, triggering immediate severe supply disruption fears and driving up prices.

alerts.title: Houthis push towards Bab el Mandeb after seizure of Mokha, raising fears for Red Sea shipping
alerts.why: Houthi advances near Bab el Mandeb threaten critical Red Sea energy shipping chokepoints, driving safe-haven demand and supply disruption fears.

itemsSent.title: Warsh's Jackson Hole speech convinced investors a rate hike was more likely but didn't tell them what would trigger one. Markets filled the gap and are now pricing a hike Warsh never promised.
itemsSent.why: Hawkish rate expectations driven by inflation focus strengthen the dollar and weigh on gold prices.

itemsSent.title: August core CPI estimates from those who have shared them: The median is 0.22%.
itemsSent.why: Benign core CPI inflation bolsters Fed rate cut bets, weakening the dollar and supporting gold prices while having limited direct oil impact.

itemsSent.title: U.S. Crude Inventories Fall As Brent Prices Soar
itemsSent.why: EIA reported a 400,000-barrel draw in U.S. crude inventories, aligning with market expectations and supporting prices amidst rising Brent benchmarks.

itemsSent.title: Surging Tanker Rates Signal Deepening Global Energy Crisis
itemsSent.why: Surging tanker rates reflect severe logistical strain in the Persian Gulf, increasing transport costs and supporting energy and safe-haven prices.

itemsSent.title: Friday's CPI inflation report is even more important than usual. Here's what to expect
itemsSent.why: Upcoming CPI release drives market positioning, but no price direction until data prints.

itemsSent.title: September OPEC+ Data Deck out now.
itemsSent.why: Saudi and Iranian production drops tighten crude supply, though partly offset by Iraqi output gains.

itemsSent.title: U.S. consumer price growth seen rising 0.3% month-on-month in August – Truflation
itemsSent.why: Inflation expectation data ahead of the Fed meeting creates mixed sentiment, unlikely to cause significant 48-hour price moves for gold or oil.

itemsSent.title: German Inflation Rate Confirmed at 4-Month High
itemsSent.why: German inflation confirms higher energy costs driven by Middle East tensions, but the data is already backward-looking and priced into markets.

itemsSent.title: Panama Canal Restrictions Are Landing on an Already Broken Chokepoint Map
itemsSent.why: Panama Canal restrictions add shipping delays but primarily impact container and dry bulk traffic, having minimal direct impact on crude oil or gold.

itemsSent.title: FUJAIRAH DATA: Oil product stocks rise record 56% in one week
itemsSent.why: Record 56% surge in Fujairah refined product inventories signals weak regional demand, pressuring crude prices downward.

itemsSent.title: Higher Oil Prices Let Mexico Pull Back Billions in Pemex Support
itemsSent.why: Higher prices driven by Middle East conflict improve Pemex cash flow, allowing reduced state support, but this reflects existing price momentum rather than new supply shock.

itemsSent.title: UN envoy warns Security Council Yemen’s war has entered ‘dangerous phase’
itemsSent.why: Houthi escalation threatens Red Sea trade routes, increasing geopolitical risk premiums for both safe-haven gold and oil shipping.
